Under this model the turn also shifts the center 13 cm right and brings the final upright bottom to the shelf plane. The requested 10/5 cm rightward move is additional to that turning motion. Physical clearance, shelf support, actual book orientation and grounded anchor must be checked before SFT; constraints are descriptive, not collision checks.
